title: Optimizations and QoL-Pack
description: A modpack with a few performance mods and quality of life features.
body:
This modpack contains mods to increase performance as well as a few nice-to-have-features such as No Chat Reports, Zoom, Smooth Scrolling, and a world map. This modpack is only client-side, and should work on virtually any server. Use on your own risk on PvP servers.

Full Mod List:

BadOptimizations
C2ME
Clumps
Cull Leaves
Dynamic FPS
Entity Culling

Fabric Language Kotlin
